summary: The customer called to complain about their internet service being disconnected without warning due to an unpaid bill. The agent apologized, verified the account number, and offered a payment extension until the fifth of the current month. The customer accepted gratefully, and the agent successfully processed the extension, restoring the service.

evidence.text: بقدر أعمل لك extension للدفع لحد تاريخ خمسة الشهر الجاري إذا بيناسبك؟
evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: Provide a payment extension until the 5th of the month.
Restore the internet service within a few minutes.
